examples/configs/traffic-management/basi.task: Forward HTTP requests to an upstream
examples/configs/traffic-management/basi.summary: A minimal HTTP reverse proxy with one listener and one upstream cluster.
prerequisites: An HTTP backend reachable from the proxy
examples/configs/traffic-management/basi.outcome: Requests received on the configured listener are forwarded to the backend.

prerequisites: Two HTTP backends reachable from the proxy
examples/configs/traffic-management/path.outcome: Requests matching configured path prefixes reach their selected backend.

prerequisites: HTTP backends for the configured hostnames
examples/configs/traffic-management/host.outcome: The request hostname selects the configured upstream.

prerequisites: At least two reachable HTTP backends
examples/configs/traffic-management/weig.outcome: Requests are distributed across endpoints according to their configured weights.

examples/configs/protocols/tls-terminati.summary: Accept HTTPS connections and forward decrypted requests to an HTTP backend.
prerequisites: Generate ./localhost+1.pem and ./localhost+1-key.pem with mkcert; the source snapshot does not include them
examples/configs/protocols/tls-terminati.outcome: The listener accepts HTTPS and forwards the request to its configured upstream.

examples/configs/traffic-management/rate.outcome: Requests within the configured limit are forwarded; excess requests are rejected.

prerequisites: A TCP backend reachable from the proxy
examples/configs/protocols/tcp-proxy.yam.outcome: Bytes flow bidirectionally between the listener and configured backend.

examples/configs/operations/hot-reload.y.outcome: A valid file change replaces the active configuration while the process stays running.

examples/configs/openai/responses/respon.summary: Forward Responses API traffic through a Praxis AI listener to a compatible backend.
examples/configs/openai/responses/respon.outcome: Responses API requests are forwarded to the configured backend.

examples/configs/openai/responses/respon.task: Translate Responses API requests for a Chat Completions backend
examples/configs/openai/responses/respon.summary: Translate the Responses API shape for an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions backend.
examples/configs/openai/responses/respon.outcome: Responses API requests are translated for the configured Chat Completions backend.

examples/configs/intelligent-route-infer.summary: Use model identity to select the matching inference backend.
examples/configs/intelligent-route-infer.outcome: The configured model identity selects an inference backend.

examples/configs/token-rate-limit.yaml.task: Limit inference traffic by estimated token cost
examples/configs/token-rate-limit.yaml.summary: Apply token-aware rate limiting to inference requests and reconcile reported usage.
examples/configs/token-rate-limit.yaml.outcome: Requests reserve token budget before forwarding and reconcile it with reported usage.
